correctness.rationale: Substitution gives the full tied endemic manifold. Exact positive relative entropy and Cauchy–Schwarz dissipation establish semisimple tangent zero eigenvalue and a strictly stable normal spectrum at all interior equilibria. Standard compact normally-hyperbolic perturbation gives uniform convergence on every bounded slow-time interval. Differentiating U_i=sum_j(k_ji/d_ji)I_ji gives U_i-prime=(KS-1+epsilon delta_i S)F_i^0 exactly, yielding G_1=h_1h_2(delta_1-delta_2)/(h_1T_2+h_2T_1); direct separation yields the weighted-logarithm law. Rational coefficients and test integrations were replayed; numeric evidence is supplemental.

value.rationale: The exact equal-potential fitness tie makes replacement arbitrarily slow under small selection, directly relevant to virulence-switch interpretation. The derived replacement law distinguishes the two phenotype-specific infectious generation-time moments even where transmission potential is identical; it gives a unique explicit timing function rather than qualitative winner-only selection. The example has distinct host-class removal and transmission rates, making the frequency-dependent clock substantive rather than an arbitrary coefficient substitution.
